cycles.behavior: bounded claim accounting and tombstone retention

cycles.behavior: unbounded predecessor count with bounded query work

cycles.red: tenant-wide purge joined every expired tombstone to generation state, so many active-generation tombstones could be rescanned before the 256-row delete limit
